channel.title: SecurityBrief New Zealand
channel.description: Technology news for CISOs & cybersecurity decision-makers

item.title: Cohesity appoints Matthew Johnston to lead APJ partner sales
item.description: The hire underscores Cohesity's push to deepen its channel reach across APJ as customers demand stronger cyber resilience and data security.
item.author: mara@techday.com (Mara Sugue)

item.title: New Zealand fractional leadership market surges 90%
item.description: Rising demand from smaller firms has pushed more than 1,000 part-time senior executives into New Zealand businesses, with AI roles growing fast.
item.author: mara@techday.com (Mara Sugue)

item.title: Adactin deploys Copilot Studio support agent for Maxi-Cash
item.description: Store staff at Maxi-Cash can now get faster technical help through a Microsoft Copilot Studio bot, after a proof-of-concept programme.
item.author: mara@techday.com (Mara Sugue)

item.title: Boards urged to tighten AI & identity cyber oversight
item.description: Boards are being warned that AI, identity and software supply chain gaps are outpacing controls, leaving organisations more exposed to fast-moving attacks.
item.author: mara@techday.com (Mara Sugue)

item.title: Secure.com says ransomware budgets should fix basics first
item.description: Most attacks still start with weak credentials, unpatched systems or phishing, so the firm says budgets should shore up basics before AI fears.
item.author: joseph@techday.com (Joseph Gabriel Lagonsin)

item.title: Keeper launches Freshservice workflow for access requests
item.description: It aims to cut delays and keep access approvals inside audited tickets, instead of forcing IT teams to move between separate systems.
item.author: mara@techday.com (Mara Sugue)

item.title: Brendan Evers named Chief Executive Officer at Spur
item.description: The reshuffle is aimed at helping Spur expand with security and fraud teams as anonymised internet traffic makes traditional signals less reliable.
item.author: mara@techday.com (Mara Sugue)

item.title: Ledger launches Atom security device for AI & crypto
item.description: It is aimed at people approving payments, identities and AI tasks on mobiles, with hardware controls designed to block spyware and mistakes.
item.author: karen@techday.com (Karen Joy Bacudo)

item.title: Commvault adds Microsoft 365 tools to spot safe backups
item.description: The new add-ons aim to help businesses avoid restoring infected files after cyberattacks, as Microsoft 365 remains a prime target for ransomware.
item.author: mara@techday.com (Mara Sugue)

item.title: Proofpoint to buy Varonis in USD $6.3 billion deal
item.description: Varonis shareholders will receive USD $49.75 a share in cash, valuing the data security group at a 52% premium and taking it private.
item.author: seanm@techday.com (Sean Mitchell)
